notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Burakos as attackers.
Burakos triggers, causing the defending player to lose at least 1 life and you to create at least one 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If you have two or more creatures in your party, you will create infinite Cat tokens, and then you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens.
